metric_definitions.comparison: one point x one calculated SGTE diagram of its system (nearest grid cell)
metric_definitions.comparable: both phase sets can be expressed as registry phases and the grid cell has an equilibrium: result agrees or disagrees
metric_definitions.agreement_rate_of_comparable: agrees / (agrees + disagrees), over all comparable comparisons (aggregate, not a per-system mean)
metric_definitions.points_agreeing_with_at_least_one_rate: points that agree with >= 1 SGTE assessment / points with >= 1 comparable comparison
metric_definitions.median_system_rate: median over systems with >= 5 comparable comparisons of the system's agreement rate
metric_definitions.not_comparable: counted separately, never in a rate; reasons in not_comparable_by_reason and, per comparison, in sgte_not_comparable.csv

ml_folds.method: `chemical_system` (sorted elements, = `system`), `paper_id` (stable source id), `fold_lso` = leave-chemical-system-out fold int(sha256(chemical_system), 16) mod 5, `fold_lpo` = leave-paper-out fold int(sha256(paper_id), 16) mod 5 (tools/ml_folds.py). Subsystems are their own systems (a held-out ternary may have its binaries in training); drop subsystems of held-out systems for strict chemistry extrapolation

cite_as.status: Version 1, machine-extracted: phase fields of expert-drawn (assessed) diagrams named by deterministic rules, model readers, an adjudicator and partial expert review (basis and review state per record); one point deep inside each field; boundary and tie-line positions are drawing-based and of low credence.
